summary: As of November 2026, mainstream LLM API pricing spans a wide range—from roughly $0.10 per million input tokens for small flagship-family models up to $10+ for frontier models, with output tokens commanding 5x the input rate on average. Prompt caching (typically 90% off cached input) and batch discounts (usually 50%) are now near-universal cost levers. Note that several models named in the original request (e.g., GPT-4o, o3, Gemini 2.5) have been superseded by newer families (GPT-6, Claude 5.x, Gemini 3.x/4), but the models below reflect confirmed, currently published API pricing on official vendor domains.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.notes: Current mid/flagship-tier OpenAI model per October 2026 catalog update. Batch requests typically half price. Pricing per million tokens.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.context_window: Same rate at any length (no long-prompt surcharge)
models.notes: Prompt caching write $2.50 (5 min) / $4.00 (1 hr); cached read $0.10. Flat rate at any prompt length. Batch discounts available.

models.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
models.notes: Promotional pricing through December 31, 2026; rises to $1.50/$7.50 on January 1, 2027. Batch requests half price. Free tier exists but Google may use content to improve products.

models.name: GPT-6 Luna
models.notes: Cheapest current-generation flagship-family OpenAI model. Batch requests typically half price.

models.name: Claude Opus 5.5
models.notes: Flagship-tier Anthropic model (pricing per CloudZero August 2026 reference for Opus 5 at $5/$25; listed as current family in October 2026 update). Batch and prompt caching discounts available.

models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models.notes: Promotional pricing through November 30, 2026; rises to $4.00 input / $20.00 output and $0.20 cached input on December 1, 2026. Batch requests half price. No free tier.

models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.notes: Top-tier frontier OpenAI model; most expensive output rate in current catalog. Batch requests typically half price.

models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.notes: Current top-tier Anthropic model; highest output rate alongside GPT-6 Astra. Batch and prompt caching discounts available.

models.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview
models.notes: Preview model. Batch requests half price. Free tier available with product-improvement data usage.

models.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
models.notes: Cheapest production-grade model (score 70+) per BenchLM.ai as of October 29, 2026. Batch requests typically half price.
